p3.title: Working from home should completely replace traditional office work.
pros: It saves time and costs associated with daily commuting.
It allows for a better work-life balance and flexible working hours.
It enables companies to hire talent globally without geographical limits.
cons: It can lead to feelings of isolation and a lack of social interaction.
It makes team collaboration, brain-storming, and clear communication harder.
Distractions at home can negatively affect productivity and discipline.
